title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox Anime
content:
Aniplus Asia announced last Friday that it will air a simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox , the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga. The simulcast will begin airing later today, October 5 at 8:30 p.m. GMT +8.

The cast members include:

• Misaki Kuno as Tanuki

• Nao Tōyama as Kitsune

• Toshiyuki Morikawa as Ōkami

• Maria Naganawa as Usagi and Narrator

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Kuma and Usagi

The manga's story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

Tommy Hino ( Kumarba (TV 3) , Crane Game Girls ) is directing the anime at Akatsuki Media Studio , and Rika Kihara ( Sylvanian Families Freya no Piece of Secret ) is writing the scripts.

The anime celebrates the franchise 's 10th anniversary.

Atamoto began serializing the manga on X (formerly Twitter ), and Frontier Works releases the manga in print. The series has already inspired a wide variety of merchandise, as well as stamps on the LINE messaging and social media app.

The franchise contains the manga's 10 volumes and three picture book volumes. The second volume of a new manga series titled Tanuki to Kitsune Yurutto will ship on October 15. The overall book franchise has 1.35 million copies in circulation.

A previous series of web anime shorts debuted in February 2018.

title: Muse India, JioHotstar Streams Hitoribocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu Anime
content:
The anime premiered in April 2019.

Muse India describes its story:

Many of us know what it is like to transition to a new school with few to no friends in a new environment, going through the arduous process of getting to know people again. Bocchi Hitori knows this struggle all too well, having just graduated from elementary school and thrown into middle school. Unfortunately, she suffers from extreme social anxiety: she faints when overwhelmed, vomits when nervous, and draws up ridiculously convoluted plans to avoid social contact. It does not help that her only friend from elementary school, Kai Yawara, will not be attending the same middle school as Bocchi. However, wanting to help her, Kai severs ties with Bocchi and promises to reconcile with her when she befriends all of her classmates in her new middle school class. Even though Bocchi has no faith in herself, she is determined to be friends with Kai again. Summoning all of her courage, Bocchi takes on the daunting challenge of making friends with her entire class, starting with the delinquent-looking girl sitting in front of her...

Takebumi Anzai ( Go! Go! 575 director, episode director for Darker than Black and Mob Psycho 100 ) directed the anime at studio C2C ( Harukana Receive , WorldEnd ). Jukki Hanada ( Beyond the Boundary , Sound! Euphonium , Steins;Gate ) both oversaw and wrote the series scripts, and Kii Tanaka ( Donten ni Warau Gaiden: Ketsubetsu, Yamainu no Chikai , Cheating Craft ) was both the character designer and chief animation director. Ryuuichi Takada and Hidekazu Tanaka of monaca composed the music, and Shigeru Saitō of Heart Company produced the music at Kadokawa .

Katsuwo ( Mitsuboshi Colors ) serialized the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Dengeki DaiohG magazine and ended it in April 2021.

title: My Isekai Life UK Blu-ray Will Be Released on Monday
content:
"As a novice level Monster Tamer, Yuji would normally be one of the last ones chosen when putting together a dungeon delving party. However, thanks to a clever trick involving a bunch of slimes, Yuji has also absorbed the archived knowledge of a great Sage and secretly gained an incredibly powerful second class! And if that's not enough, he's actually from a place called Japan in another world, which adds even more tricks up his sleeve! But even with these abilities and the help of his slimes, a magical Proud Wolf, and a forest spirit named Dryad, will that be enough to face off against rock dragons, sinister cults and gangs of slavers?"

Keisuke Kojima ( I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level , Babylon ) directed the anime and designed the characters at REVOROOT . Kiyotaka Suzuki ( FLCL Alternative ) was the assistant director. Naohiro Fukushima ( I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level ) handled the series scripts. Norihito Saitama was the chief animation director and additional character designer.

Three-member rock band Non Stop Rabbit performed the opening theme song "Mujikaku no Tensai" (Obliviously Talented). Surachanzu△, a voice actor unit composed of the six cast members who play the slimes in the show, performed the ending theme song "Gohan da yo! Dadadadan!!" The members include Hikaru Tohno (Sura), Mai Kanno (Surapacchi), Haruna Mikawa (Mayusawa), Erisa Kuon (Saruhappa), Nichika Ōmori (Higesura), and Miharu Hanai (Pekesura).

SB Creative 's GA Novel imprint began publishing the story with illustrations by Huuka Kazabana in 2018. PONJEA launched the manga adaptation in 2018. Square Enix Manga & Books licensed the manga adaptation with the title My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World! .

title: Muse India Streams The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime
content:
The Muse India Instagram account has also posted countdowns for second season of the television anime of writer Buncololi and illustrator Kantoku 's Sasaki and Peeps ( Sasaki and Pichan ) novels, where it has not confirmed the broadcast platforms for the season. Crunchyroll will stream the anime season in India.

The second season of the The Detective Is Already Dead will also stream on Crunchyroll and get dubs in English and Hindi.

Manabu Kurihara returns to direct the second season at ENGI . Deko Akao is again in charge of series scripts, and Yōsuke Itō is again designing the characters.

40mP is composing the anime's music, along with composing, arranging, and writing the lyrics for the theme songs. Kōme performs the opening "Kono Shinzō ni Hanabata wo" (A Bouquet for This Heart), and Kagura Nana returns to perform the ending "Hakuchumu" (Daydreams).

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Muse Asia streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The channel discontinued streaming the anime in October 2021. The Muse India YouTube channel began streaming it in June 2023. Crunchyroll added a Hindi dub for the anime in August 2023.

Nigojū published the first volume in the light novel series with illustrations by Umibōzu in November 2019 under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J imprint. The novel won the 15th MF Bunko J newcomer award in 2019. Kadokawa published the 13th volume in July 2025. Yen Press is publishing the original novels in English.

Hoko Hinachi and Minori Chigusa launched a new spinoff novel titled Charlotte wa Tada, Jiken o Tokitai. Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. Code:RED in May 2024. Nigojū is credited for the original work and as a supervisor for the novel.

Mugiko launched the manga adaptation of the novels in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in May 2020, and ended it in October 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume in October 2023.

title: The New Denpa Men Game Ends Service on December 7
content:
The game has halted sales of in-game Jewel currency and other paid items on Tuesday. The website will detail information regarding refunds of unused in-game currency after the game ends service.

The game launched as a timed exclusive for Nintendo Switch in July 2024 and later got releases on iOS and Android devices. The game got a Nintendo Switch 2 version on April 5.

Genius Sorority released the first Denpa Ningen no RPG game for Nintendo 3DS in Japan in February 2012. Nintendo released the game in North America and Europe later that year with the title The Denpa Men: They Came By Wave . The game received three more installments on Nintendo 3DS, two of which ( The Denpa Men 2: Beyond the Waves and The Denpa Men 3: The Rise of Digitoll ) received Western releases. The Denpa Men RPG Free! , the first free-to-play game in the series, was released in Japan in July 2014. Genius Sorority released all four installments in the series digitally.

The New Denpa Ningen no RPG game arrived for smartphones in February 2017.

In the games, players capture the titular Denpa Men to create a party and tackle dungeons. Players use cameras to find nearby Denpa Men in their surroundings and capture them.

title: 10 Years Ago, Pokemon Released Its Coolest Anime Yet & It Needs to Return
content:
While most anime fans might be familiar with the adventures of Ash Ketchum in the anime adaptation of Pokemon , following him on his decades long journey to become a Pokemon champion across every new region that gets introduced to the franchise, his adventure isn’t the only story to be animated. For Pokemon fans yearning for an animated adaptation that’s more faithful to the lore from the game, 2016’s Pokemon Generations offered just that, even if it was a short-form anthology collection. Produced by OLM, the same animation studio that handles the animation for Ash’s Pokemon adventures as well as heavy-hitting season anime like The Apothecary Diaries and Komi Can’t Communicate , Pokemon Generations was an 18-episode series released on YouTube that adapted key moments from the games.

Pokemon Generations was an incredibly unique spin on the Pokemon anime’s format , with its first episode starting just like one would expect — with a young, aloof Pokemon trainer catching a Pikachu in the wild and embarking on their very own journey throughout Kanto, taking them all the way to Kalos. Subsequent episodes look at vignettes that capture other key characters and moments throughout the franchise, like Detective Looker investigating the Viridian City Gym only to discover that the gym leader, Giovanni, has fled following a recent battle.

Pokemon Generations Was One Of The Anime’s Most Unique Concept In Years

Pokemon succeeded in its timeless characterization of Ash Ketchum, creating a protagonist that was capable of journeying to every region throughout the Pokemon franchise and taking on its most iconic trainers. However, for many longtime fans, the series’s climactic final battles, which would pit Ash against the region’s champion only to lose or tie the match in some way became something of a running joke. In Pokemon Generations , though, fans of the franchise get more of an “outside looking in” perspective, capturing small moments from each region that have major impact on the canon lore of the video game franchise as opposed to reimagining story beats from the games to fit with Ash’s journey.

Many of the shorts in Pokemon Generations are from the perspective of Detective Looker, an NPC introduced to the franchise in 2008’s Pokemon Platinum , a revamped fourth generation Pokemon game that introduced a “definitive” story line , improving upon the story from Diamond and Pearl . Looker becomes a recurring character in the franchise after, appearing in Pokemon X and Y , Sun and Moon , as well as Black and White . However, there are plenty of vignettes that hint at the main player character stepping in to save the day as well, with Episode 15 of the series showing a heated battle between Ghetsis and N from Pokemon Black and White , just as the main player character to swoop in as the episode ends to save the day. The format was remarkably enchanting, hitting all the right nostalgia notes for longtime fans of the series while scratching the itch many Pokemon fans have to see more accurate animated adaptations.

Will Pokemon Fans Ever Get Another Anime Like Generations Again?

Pokemon Generations released on The Pokemon Company’s YouTube channel in 2016, and while there hasn’t been a direct sequel to the collection, Pokemon has released another, similar series of shorts: Pokemon Evolutions , an 8-episode mini series designed to celebrate the franchise’s 25th anniversary in 2021. The episodes featured in Evolutions had runtimes being anywhere between six to ten minutes in length, which was comparable to Generations , plus, Evolutions ‘s episodes each focus on events happening in individual regions representing each generation of Pokemon , spotlighting different fan favorite characters and expanding on already established lore.

Poketoons has also bee running since 2021, though, the collection of shorts are more focused on showcasing different animator’s adapting small adventures unrelated to the games. Aside from Pokemon Evolutions , nothing has quite captured the anthological magic Pokemon Generations gave to fans of the series, but that doesn’t mean the community doesn’t want more. Pokemon Generations was incredibly well received by fans despite its brief narrative pacing due to episode length. However, despite episodes of the series raking in millions of views on YouTube, as of writing, The Pokemon Company and Studio OLM haven’t announced an official continuation or sequel to the series.

Do you want to see a new era of Pokémon Generations ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Hunter X Hunter Manga Creator Yoshihiro Togashi to Limit Work Due to Physical/Mental Health Issues
content:
Togashi's Hunter X Hunter manga went back on hiatus on September 7 after having resumed serialization on June 29. The manga left off in its 420th chapter, and Togashi recently posted an update on September 15 stating that he had finished the manuscript for the 428th chapter. Shueisha published the manga's 39th compiled book volume (image right), its first volume in 22 months, on July 3. The manga has exceeded 100 million copies in circulation (including digital copies).
